text:
The statute will most likely be declared constitutional, with no equal protection violation, because states may require a reasonable showing of public support from independent and minor-party candidates, and the 7% signature requirement with a 180-day circulation period is not unduly burdensome and treats party and non-party candidates comparably. Courts uphold such ballot-access schemes under Anderson v. Celebrezze when the burden is reasonable and the deadlines are consistent across candidate types.
CONFIDENCE: 80
